purpose: Terminal-native voice-to-image reference retrieval tool for visual artists on Fedora 44

origin_story.need: Find reference images by speaking or typing natural descriptions
origin_story.workflow: Voice/text query → search local image library → open results in image viewer on drawing tablet
origin_story.constraints: Local-first only, no cloud APIs, no heavy GPU compute, terminal-first approach

displays.DP-3: 3328x1872 — XP-Pen drawing display (primary, images open here)

vision_model.name: bartowski/qwen2-vl-2b-instruct
vision_model.json_reliability: POOR — hallucinates, outputs dicts instead of strings, copies examples, malformed JSON
vision_model.quality: Acceptable for basic captions, unreliable for structured output

voice_model.name: vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15
voice_model.status: Downloaded but UNUSED — no microphone available

index_status.approach: Multi-lens (3 captions per image: character, environment, color/motion/composition/narrative)
index_status.method: Single API call per image, auto-resize to 1024px, save incrementally

voice.blocker: No microphone, Bluetooth dead, Vosk unused

features: Auto-detects LM Studio IP on first run
Interactive loop: type query → search → open images

search.expansion: DISABLED — LLM query expansion was non-deterministic
search.fallback: None — no substring or semantic fallback

viewer.mode: One window per image, tiled horizontally (3328px / N images)

active_scripts: friday_text.py — Main pipeline (text input → search → feh on XP-Pen)
reindex_all.py — Full re-indexer (minimal prompt, generic example)
inactive_scripts: survey_domains.py — Debug tool, shows all captions

working_commands.find_lm_studio: Auto-detected on first run of friday_text.py

tested_queries.reason: Exact word matching only — 'warrior' not in captions, 'swords' plural not matched, compound queries fail

development_history.session_1: Initial setup — single-caption expert indexing with Qwen VL 7B, CLIP search rejected
development_history.session_2: Continued — webp conversion, basic search working
development_history.session_3: Speed focus — multi-lens design, single-call indexing, concurrent test (16× speedup but cache artifact)
development_history.session_4: Current — text input pipeline, auto-detect API, XP-Pen viewer, 3 re-index attempts, JSON reliability issues

what_works: Type query → search local captions → open matching images on XP-Pen display
Multiple results open as separate tiled windows
Auto-detects LM Studio IP after reboot
Combat images findable by: combat, samurai, sword, training
what_is_broken: Qwen2 VL 2B cannot reliably output structured JSON — 3 images failed re-indexing
Exact-word search misses valid results ('warrior' vs 'warriors', 'sword' vs 'swords')
3 images have empty/broken captions from JSON parse failures
rejected_for_mvp: Clicky cursor pet / persistent mascot — distraction
Local LLM for general chat — out of scope
CLIP embeddings — user explicitly rejected, wants LLM-only
Concurrent indexing — VRAM crash on Arc A750

critical: Fix search to substring matching (so 'war' finds 'warrior', 'sword' finds 'swords')
Manually fix or delete 3 broken image captions
Test with random words: tree, blue, angry, city, alone, fire, female, portrait
important: Add search result ranking by relevance score
Improve reindex_all.py prompt to prevent example copying
Consider plain-text output instead of JSON for reliability
future: Larger VL model (7B+) for reliable structured output
Tablet pen button trigger for voice/text
Batch overnight indexing for new reference folders
Search by specific lens: --lens narrative 'tense scene'

open_questions: Should we switch to plain-text captions (no JSON) to avoid model hallucination?
Should we get a USB headset or fix Bluetooth for voice input?
Should we try Qwen2 VL 7B despite slower speed for better JSON reliability?
Should we add more images to the library (current: 20)?

mvp_assessment.text_pipeline: 80% complete — works for common queries, misses some
mvp_assessment.search_quality: 60% complete — exact word only, no semantics
mvp_assessment.viewer: 90% complete — opens on correct monitor, tiled windows work
mvp_assessment.overall: Tier 1 (Beginner) is functional but not polished. Ready for daily use with caveats.

confidence: Will hit MVP if voice is deprioritized and search fixes are made in next 1-2 sessions
